SETTINGS_SYNC.Title: Settings Sync
SETTINGS_SYNC.Menu.Name: Settings Sync
SETTINGS_SYNC.Menu.Label: Compare Worlds
SETTINGS_SYNC.Menu.Hint: Compare this world's enabled modules and settings against another world, and pull across the differences.
SETTINGS_SYNC.Setting.AutoPublish.Name: Publish this world automatically
SETTINGS_SYNC.Setting.AutoPublish.Hint: Write a snapshot of this world when it loads, so other worlds can compare against it. Without this, a world only becomes a comparison target when you publish it by hand.
SETTINGS_SYNC.Setting.PublishInterval.Hi: Automatic publishing is skipped if this world's snapshot is newer than this. Set to 0 to publish on every load.
SETTINGS_SYNC.NoTargetsHint: No other world has published a snapshot yet. Launch another world with Settings Sync enabled, or import a snapshot file.
SETTINGS_SYNC.FilteredOut: Differences here are hidden by the current filters.
SETTINGS_SYNC.Tooltip.Refresh: Re-read the snapshots and rebuild the comparison
SETTINGS_SYNC.Tooltip.Publish: Publish a snapshot of this world now
SETTINGS_SYNC.Tooltip.Import: Import a snapshot file from another install
SETTINGS_SYNC.Tooltip.Export: Download this world's snapshot as a file
SETTINGS_SYNC.Tooltip.SelectAll: Skips rows flagged with a warning; tick those by hand
SETTINGS_SYNC.Note.UserScope: User-scope settings belong to a user id, and user ids are per-world. These are the snapshotting user's, and applying them writes them to you.
SETTINGS_SYNC.Note.ClientScope: Client settings live in this browser's storage, keyed without a world prefix — every world served from this address already shares them. Two worlds on the same install will always agree here, and applying a row changes that setting for all of them.
SETTINGS_SYNC.Warning.SystemMismatch: These worlds run different systems ({here} here, {there} there). System settings cannot be applied.
SETTINGS_SYNC.Warning.SystemVersion: System versions differ: {here} here, {there} there. A setting's meaning may have changed between them.
SETTINGS_SYNC.Module.NotInstalled: Not installed here — enable it in Add-on Modules first.
SETTINGS_SYNC.Blocked.core_moduleConfigu: This is the Modules list above; change it there.
SETTINGS_SYNC.Blocked.core_compendiumCon: Holds compendium pack ids, including packs local to that world.
SETTINGS_SYNC.Blocked.core_systemMigrati: Copying this would make the system skip or repeat migrations.
SETTINGS_SYNC.Blocked.migration: Migration bookkeeping — copying it would make the package skip or repeat migrations.
SETTINGS_SYNC.Blocked.systemMismatch: The two worlds run different systems.
SETTINGS_SYNC.Blocked.worldState: Campaign data for this world, not a preference.
SETTINGS_SYNC.Caution.documentIds: References documents by id. Applying replaces the whole value, dropping entries only this world has.
SETTINGS_SYNC.Caution.currentDate: Includes the calendar's current date. Applying moves this world's date too.
SETTINGS_SYNC.Confirm.Title: Apply Settings
SETTINGS_SYNC.Confirm.Body: Apply {count} change(s) from "{world}" to this world? This overwrites the current values and cannot be undone.
SETTINGS_SYNC.Error.BadSnapshot: That file is not a Settings Sync snapshot this version can read.
SETTINGS_SYNC.Error.PublishFailed: Could not write {file} to the snapshot store. See the console for the server's reason.
